notes.title: 16.08.2022 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
[h2]Here is what we have changed:[/h2]

[h3][list]
[*][b]Added the ability to jump.[/b]
[*][b]Removed camera shaking.[/b]
[*]Fixed a bug where you could get stuck near a lamp in the room with fire.
[/list][/h3]

notes.title: ESCAPE IT RELEASE!
notes.content:
[h3][b]The game is now available for purchase to anyone! Try to Escape It now![/b][/h3]

You can now purchase the game on its [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2075250/ESCAPE_IT/]STORE PAGE![/url][/b]

If you need [b]any[/b] help during your escape, we have made a [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2847612919]COMPLETION GUIDE[/url][/b] which has answers to all puzzles. If you are stuck or just bored you could use that to help you :)
